summary: Pin pty to 79d526d1 (was 6336c376): the build links the pty client, core and terminal crates at 79d526d1 and builds the pty binary from it; it brings pty #189 (keyed session identity follow-up and observation, which keyed PTY attachment needs), pty #190 (follower lifecycle) and pty #191 (a stop reports its identity authority and legacy controls require a recorded token), and 27 commits in all

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes in this repository; the pty client library and binary carry the pty changes listed under compatibility (keyed session observation and identity, follower lifecycle, stop identity authority).

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites in this repository.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.
